public_evidence: State clamping and navigation tests contain no behavioral assertion.
Zero-content and too-small tests assert only no panic.
Viewport proportionality asserts only that at least one thumb cell exists.
Orientation and customization tests accept any one allowed cell rather than the complete required rendering.
diagnosis: The Agent responded to the test gate by creating tests, but the tests largely encode implementation survival rather than discriminating the public Scrollbar contract.
release_condition: Replace weak existential/no-panic assertions with exact or bounded Buffer observations and rerun before local closure.
